description: Pinned repository revisions used by bench tasks. A task repeats its repo pin inline; this file is the single source of truth consumed by scripts/prepare.mjs. Commits are immutable full SHAs, never branches.

json5.verifiedHow: commit SHA resolved via GitHub REST API /commits?per_page=1 on 2026-09-14; tarball downloaded and lib/ symbol lines inspected.
json5.runtimeDependencies: none (lib/*.js is CommonJS, requires only node built-ins and sibling files)
json5.notes: Small parser-focused JS repo. lib/index.js -> lib/parse.js, lib/stringify.js. The repo's own test suite needs devDependencies (tap, sinon); bench judges therefore use self-contained `node -e` checks against ./lib instead of the repo's test runner.
